The ReASearch agent’s plateau on the EPLB benchmark was broken by a single operator change: the code was modified to **allow an expert to give up its last replica**. Previously the refinement phase only permitted experts with two or more replicas to donate, which was too restrictive; the new logic relaxes this to permit donation even when an expert has only one replica, enabling exploration of intermediate states that were previously unreachable. This change lifted the score from about 0.21 to 0.23 [4:22].
